validation.case_scope: Recovered ACB120 periodic effect sweep: status countdown and linked expiry, growth/stat restoration, random status changes, petrification/death transitions, periodic HP damage, HP/MP regeneration, result snapshots, low-health flags, temporary-duration masks and both-side gauge maintenance. Guest constants and tables remain external. Focused composed checks cover expiring properties, damage followed by regeneration, action snapshots, duration 99 sentinel, preserved state and mode-zero gauge-only behavior. Random/status/death branches are source-derived but not exhaustively tested; no gameplay or bitwise floating-point acceptance claimed.
